name: Tablet Cast (v3, Velum)
author: henri
description: While the tablet shows this Mac (mac-cast through ipadcast): the tablet and its battery in the menu bar; a click grows the right island into its numbers — battery, draw, latency, connection, frame and data rate, screen —, a brightness slider for its panel, switches for its keyboard light and for which keyboard and trackpad work this Mac, and how the sync with it stands — one row, its files, conflicts, settings and dotfiles on a page of their own. Hidden while no tablet is connected.

barWidget.description: The casting tablet, its battery and stream; only while it is connected
